name: DNS Zone Manager
postCreateCommand: git config --global --add safe.directory /workspace && npm install && go mod download && pre-commit install && pre-commit install-hooks
postStartCommand:
sudo mkdir -p /etc/bind && if [ -f /etc/rndc.conf ] && [ ! -e /etc/bind/rndc.conf ]; then sudo ln -sf /etc/rndc.conf /etc/bind/rndc.conf; fi; if [ -S /var/run/docker.sock ]; then DOCKER_GID=$(stat -c '%g' /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null || stat -f '%g' /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$DOCKER_GID" ]; then getent group docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || sudo groupadd -g $DOCKER_GID docker 2>/dev/null || sudo groupadd docker 2>/dev/null || true; getent group docker >/dev/null 2>&1 && sudo usermod -aG docker vscode 2>/dev/null || true; fi; sudo chmod 666 /var/run/docker.sock 2>/dev/null || true; fi && echo '
✅ Devcontainer ready!

🚀 Start services:
   Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+P → Tasks: Run Build Task
   Or: Terminal → Run Build Task

🔗 URLs (after starting):
   App (API key): http://localhost:8000  (key: dev)
   App (OIDC):    http://localhost:8080  (ENTRA + TRAEFIK tasks)
   Docs:          http://localhost:8000/docs
   Entra portal:  http://localhost:8444
   Traefik:       http://localhost:8081
   Webhooks UI:   http://localhost:5080  (WEBHOOKS task; Teams sink)
   Grafana:       http://localhost:3000
   Auth: API key on :8000; OIDC (user1@dns-zone-manager.test / pass1) via Traefik
   Note: first time with Traefik/webhook ports → Rebuild Container once

🖥️  dns-cli (after the API is up):
   dns-cli list zones
   dns-cli auth login --url http://localhost:8080
   dns-cli --url http://localhost:8080 list zones
   dns-cli list records example.com.
   dns-cli schedule list
   dns-cli zone create new.example.
   dns-cli rndc status

🧪 Testing:
   ./tests.sh              # Unit tests only
   ./tests.sh --all        # All tests (unit + integration + E2E)
   npm run test:e2e:ui     # Playwright UI → http://localhost:9323
   npm run test:e2e:report # Test report  → http://localhost:9324

🔧 DNS Tools (dig):
   dig @bind -p 15353 example.com           # Query A record
   dig @bind -p 15353 example.com ANY        # Query all records
   dig @bind -p 15353 example.com SOA +short # SOA serial

📦 Zone Transfers (AXFR/IXFR):
   dig @bind -p 15353 example.com AXFR -k /etc/dns-api-key.conf
   dig @bind -p 15353 example.com IXFR=12345 -k /etc/dns-api-key.conf

✏️  Dynamic Updates (nsupdate):
   nsupdate -k /etc/dns-api-key.conf <<EOF
   server bind 15353
   zone example.com
   update add test.example.com 300 A 192.0.2.100
   send
   EOF

🔧 RNDC Server Control:
   rndc status
   rndc zonestatus example.com

🗄️  Scheduled Change Store (PostgreSQL):
   psql postgresql://dns_zone_manager:devpassword@postgres:5432/dns_zone_manager
   psql ... -c "SELECT id, name, zone, status FROM scheduled_changes;"
   Host clients: localhost:15432 (data resets on container restart)
'
